audit_items.proof_trace: Line 143 directly implements the assertion: `self.cash_reserve = self.cash_reserve.add(reserve_factor.mul(interest_accumulated))`, where `interest_accumulated = debt * simple_interest_factor` is the interest_earned. The lenders' exchange rate denominator (`cash + debt - cash_reserve`) increases by exactly `(1 - reserve_factor) * interest_accumulated`, confirming the reserve_factor portion goes exclusively to cash_reserve. All market operations (deposit, borrow, repay, liquidate) unconditionally call `market.accrue_interest` — which always passes `asset.repay_fee_rate()` as reserve_factor — before any state change, so no bypass path exists.
